verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state users can 'Use without an account' and 'still generate codes without an internet connection or mobile service,' directly matching the story's requirement for fully offline TOTP generation without a vendor account. Community threads discuss sync/backup pitfalls but do not contradict the offline-generation claim itself. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that offline mode works flawlessly and no first-party technical detail on how offline HOTP/TOTP secrets are stored locally.
